messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD#23567 - model-catalog auto-promotion detected -> revision 7 (was 5). Severity: P1. Symptoms: generation errors, tokenization anomalies, elevated 5xx. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/cat-auto-promo
pagerduty: Notification: Escalated to oncall rota. Primary: @sam
maya: ack — I'm on it. pinging runtime + catalog. assigning lead.
sam: ack (via PD). Any customer-facing impact? Should we page SRE?
nina: seeing elevated 500s on /v1/generate for AcmePayments and PayFlow. Error sample: "tokenize failed: unknown token at pos 0". p95 latency 400ms -> 1.2s.
maya: quick triage: auto-promotion job pushed rev7 which includes experimental tokenizer flag "bpv2". rev7 isn't validated for live traffic. Revert plan: pin routes to rev5, disable auto-promote, rollback if green.
sam: what's the exact rollback sequence?
maya: commands to run:
```
# pin route
catalogctl route pin --model-id rwd-paygen --route default --rev 5
# disable auto promote
catalogctl settings set auto_promote false
# rollback promotion
catalogctl rollback --model-id rwd-paygen --to-rev 5
```
devops-bot: queued rolling-restart for serving-pool rwd-paygen-prod (scale 0->up) — awaiting approval.
maya: executing pin now.
maya: pinned route -> rev5 :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: PD#23567 status: acknowledged by maya. Next escalation window in 12m.
nina: still ~2% 500s, looks like some nodes still routing to rev7 via cache. Suggest runtime KV/prefix cache flush.
sam: runtime team — can you flush KV cache for rwd-paygen? suggested cmd:
```
runtimectl cache flush --model rwd-paygen --scope route
```
leo: taking monitoring. initiated cache flush now.
leo: cache flush complete. observability: p95 latency back to ~420ms, error rate down to 0.2% but some customers still report odd outputs.
nina: AcmePayments sent a bad transcript (garbled tokens). forwarding minimal excerpt separately.
maya: logs show some older edge nodes running an older binary that ignores route pin. opening infra ticket to force deploy those nodes.
sam: keep PD open until stable and notify customers. any requests for immediate customer comms?
nina: opened support case SUP-788 for AcmePayments (high). They've asked for rollback confirmation and ETA on fix.
maya: actions:
- maya: continue rollback + monitor (this thread)
- leo: sweep and restart stale nodes
- sam: PD + customer comms
- nina: own support case and updates
incident-bot: PD#23567 escalated to SRE lead due to extended ack window.
maya: handing off active mitigation to next oncall in 30m — @leo will take over. please update thread.
leo: ack — taking handoff. will coordinate infra and post updates.
sam: noted for postmortem. recommending disabling auto-promo permanently until QA for bpv2 tokenizer is added.
devops-bot: deploy: forced restarts 4/6 nodes done, 2 pending.
leo: 4/6 complete, 2 redeploying. p95 trending to baseline.
nina: support updated AcmePayments with rollback notice. they requested adding tokenization regression tests to promo pipeline.
maya: agreed — include in postmortem action items.
leo: system stable on my watch. will close PD in 10m if no regression.
pagerduty: PD#23567 resolved by leo. Status: closed.
